semiconductor_relevance: High — Nanotech Inc. specializes in in-situ monitoring sensors for semiconductor and display processes, making it a relevant supplier in the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem.
summary: Nanotech Inc. develops and manufactures advanced sensor products for process diagnostics in semiconductor and display mass production. Their key offerings include Self-plasma Optical Emission Spectrometers and End Point Detectors, which are integrated with customized software for effective process control.

regional_presence.Korea: Nanotech Inc. is located in R.Korea and focuses on developing high-tech solutions for the semiconductor industry.
